title: Any way to convert c10::cuda::CUDAStream from and to torch.cuda.Stream
error_description: I want to subclass ProcessGroupNCCL to enable communication using a user-specified CUDA stream. It seems that `c10::cuda::CUDAStream` cannot be converted to and from Python's `torch.cuda.Stream`. I think converting a torch.cuda.Stream back and forth between Python and C++ should be a very common need. Does PyTorch provide any built-in helpers for this conversion?
repro_output: Any way to convert c10::cuda::CUDAStream from and to torch.cuda.Stream

trigger_conditions.other_conditions: Using custom ProcessGroupNCCL subclass with torch.cuda.Stream
